name: John E. Page
role: Member of the Quorum of the Twelve, 1838–1846
dateNote: Section 118 named him to the Twelve on 8 July 1838; he was ordained on 19 December 1838.
importance: John E. Page was baptized in Ohio in 1833 and in 1838 led a company of converts from Upper Canada to Missouri. Section 118 names him to fill one of the vacancies in the Twelve. Section 124 lists him among the apostles in 1841. He was removed from the Twelve and excommunicated in 1846, and later backed James Strang and other groups.
connections: Section 118 names him with John Taylor, Wilford Woodruff, and Willard Richards. Emer Harris baptized him.

sources.title: John Edward Page, Joseph Smith Papers biography
